stories.title: Nepal's 'miracle' takes them into World Cup Qualifiers
stories.subTitle: World Cricket League Division Two 2018
stories.seoTitle: Nepal's 'miracle' takes them into World Cup Qualifiers
stories.summary: With one wicket in hand, Nepal needed eight off the final over. The first four balls were dots, but Karan KC's six off the fifth ball propelled them to an improbable win against Canada

stories.title: Lamichhane, Basant help Nepal pull off one-wicket heist
stories.subTitle: World Cricket League Division Two 2018
stories.seoTitle: Sandeep Lamichhane, Basant Regmi help Nepal pull off one-wicket heist
stories.summary: Canada's seamers skittled Oman for 106 in 27.4 overs and set up a thumping eight-wicket win while a trio of fifties helped UAE vault past Kenya by 218 runs
